def pow_mod(base, power, mod):
    r = 1
    while power:
        if power % 2:
            r = (r * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        power //= 2
    return r

MOD = 10**9 + 7

    p_str, k_str = line.strip().split()

    k = int(k_str)
    if k == 0:
        print(pow_mod(p, p - 1, MOD))
        continue
    if k == 1:
        print(pow_mod(p, p, MOD))
        continue
    bs = [False] * p
    pow_count = 0
    for i in range(1, p):
        if bs[i]:
            continue
        j = i
        w = 0
        while not bs[j]:
            w += 1
            bs[j] = True
            j = (j * k) % p
        if pow_mod(k, w, p) == 1:
            pow_count += 1
    print(pow_mod(p, pow_count, MOD))
